“My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is made perfect in weakness.” 2 Corinthians 12:9

The world worships strength.

Babylon builds monuments to the self-made, the gifted, the ones who climbed their way to the top.

Its gospels are etched in résumés, platforms, and polished stories of success.

But YHVH operates differently.

He bypasses the palaces and goes straight to the desert.

He ignores the boardrooms and walks into the wilderness.

He doesn’t call the qualified—He qualifies the called.

And He always starts with the broken.

🪖 THE UNLIKELY ARMY

Look at His recruiting record:

  • Moses — A prince turned fugitive with a stutter and a murder charge.
  • Gideon — Hiding at the bottom of a winepress from the Midianites.
  • David — The forgotten son left tending sheep.
  • Rahab — A Canaanite prostitute in a city under judgment.
  • Mary — An unknown girl from a nowhere town.
  • Peter — An uneducated fisherman with a temper and weak faith.

God doesn’t screen for capability.

He screens for surrender.

He doesn’t want your strength.

He wants your yes.

⚔️ THE DIVINE STRATEGY

This isn’t a feel-good story about underdogs.

This is spiritual warfare tactics at the highest level.

Babylon’s system is built on pride, perception, and human merit.

So God attacks its very foundation by using what Babylon discards.

  • He shames the strong by lifting the weak.
  • He silences the wise by speaking through the simple.
  • He humiliates the proud by honoring the humble.

When a shepherd boy takes down a giant, no one praises the boy.

They fear his God.

When a prostitute helps bring down Jericho, no one credits her past.

They remember her faith.

God uses broken vessels so clearly—that no one doubts where the power comes from.

🧭 THE REMNANT'S ADVANTAGE

If you feel unqualified, overwhelmed, or marked by failure—You are not out of the running.

You are exactly where YHVH wants you. Your weakness isn’t a liability.

It’s your greatest asset.

Your past doesn’t disqualify you.

It equips you.

Your insecurity isn’t a sign of unbelief.

It’s evidence that you know—you aren’t enough on your own.

And that is the starting point of every true move of God.

🛡 THE CALL

Stop trying to fix yourself before you answer Him.

Stop waiting until you’re "ready."

You never will be.

Come broken.

Come uncertain.

Come empty-handed.

That is where He meets you.

Not in your strength, but in your surrender.

Not in your confidence, but in your need.

He doesn’t want your résumé.

He wants your availability.

Your weakness is not something to hide.

It is the very thing through which He will show His strength.

You are not too damaged.

You are perfectly positioned.

The world is watching the strong fall.

The remnant is watching the broken rise.

Share this with one person who needs to remember their weakness is a weapon.
